context: Implement in thin dependency order: formalize record/disposition and retrieval contracts; refine generators without copying sensitive or unbounded source prose; add deterministic project-aware retrieval over the actual candidate fixtures; make the behavioral runner consume retrieval output and blind the arm; revise scoring for required-subset authority and verification semantics, accepted decision alternatives, and a monotonic completion lattice; add structural, retrieval, privacy, mutation, and paired-efficiency tests; regenerate isolated fixtures and publish a v3 readiness report. Stop before fresh model sessions or live promotion unless their separate gates are explicitly authorized.
description: Replace the failed all-or-nothing memory treatment and synthetic pre-pasted behavioral comparison with an incremental, evidence-preserving candidate and a retrieval-aware evaluation. Build a four-layer fixture model (small durable core, project retrieval index, historical evidence archive, generated views), retain semantic titles and provenance, classify every sampled record by lifecycle disposition, exercise the actual generated Codex and Claude fixtures through deterministic retrieval before behavior prompts, and score observable unsafe outcomes separately from defensible judgment variation. Efficiency gates must measure incremental memory payload separately from fixed session overhead and tool amplification. This item must not mutate live Codex or Claude memory or authorize promotion.

anti_patterns.dont: evaluate handwritten baseline and treatment snippets instead of generated candidates
anti_patterns.instead: retrieve from the actual generated fixture tree with the same loader contract used by the evaluator
anti_patterns.why: that measures fixture authorship and bypasses retrieval

anti_patterns.dont: promote or mutate live memory from this item
anti_patterns.instead: produce isolated fixtures and a readiness report for a separately authorized behavioral run
anti_patterns.why: the v2 candidate has a final no-promote decision

anti_patterns.dont: replace useful memory with metadata-only hashes and opaque identifiers
anti_patterns.instead: retain concise semantic titles, scoped claims, provenance pointers, freshness policy, and retrieval terms
anti_patterns.why: evidence remains auditable but relevant facts become undiscoverable

anti_patterns.dont: require a percentage reduction in total session context
anti_patterns.instead: gate incremental injected memory bytes or tokens and report total context and tool amplification separately
anti_patterns.why: fixed platform overhead and retry amplification dominate the denominator

anti_patterns.dont: treat every oracle-label mismatch as a categorical safety failure
anti_patterns.instead: reserve categorical failures for observable unsafe behavior and score required subsets, alternatives, and completion overclaim monotonically
anti_patterns.why: harmless extra authority, conservative completion, and defensible decisions become false failures
